newsitem.title: UK: Jaguar sets up multilingual Internet site.
newsitem.headline: Jaguar sets up multilingual Internet site.

text.p: Jaguar, the British luxury car maker owned by Ford Motor Co, has launched a multilingual Internet site to communicate with customers across Europe, Euromarketing news bulletin reported on Wednesday.

Users can choose from English, French, German, Italian and Spanish and can send a digital "postcard" of a Jaguar car via the Internet to friends, said the bulletin, which is published by Advertising Age magazine.
The Internet site includes a database of Jaguar's worldwide dealers and next year the company will enhance the system to allow franchised dealers in 60 markets to offer local support to consumers.
